absence.definition: The state of not being present
absence.example: His frequent absence from class surprised the teacher.

against.definition: In opposition to someone or something
against.example: We must fight against climate change together.

agricultural.definition: Related to farming and growing crops
agricultural.example: This region is known for its productive agricultural land.

authorities.definition: People with official power to make decisions
authorities.example: The local authorities decided to close the flooded road.

crops.definition: Plants grown by farmers for food
crops.example: The farmers harvest their crops in the late summer.

deal with.definition: To take action to solve a problem.
deal with.example: Teachers must deal with many student problems daily.

death.example: His sudden death shocked the entire town.

debris.definition: Broken pieces left after something is destroyed.
debris.example: Rescue workers searched the debris for survivors.

degradation.definition: The process of becoming worse in quality.
degradation.example: Soil degradation is a major environmental problem.

destroy.definition: To damage something so badly that it cannot exist.
destroy.example: Fire can quickly destroy a large forest.

disagree.example: I disagree with your opinion on this topic.

dry.example: You should dry your clothes in the sun.

educate.example: We need to educate children about healthy eating.

eruption.definition: A sudden explosion of a volcano.
eruption.example: The sudden volcanic eruption caused panic in the city.

fatal.example: Smoking can cause a fatal disease.

force.example: The strong wind can force the doors open.

government.definition: The group of people who rule a country.
government.example: The government will introduce a new law next week.

harm.example: Pollution can harm wild animals in the forest.

lava.definition: Hot liquid rock that flows from a volcano.
lava.example: Hot lava destroyed the small village.

reduce.definition: Make smaller or less in amount.
reduce.example: We need to reduce our waste.

rise up.example: The people will rise up against tyranny.

rock.definition: Solid mineral material forming part of Earth.
rock.example: He sat on a large rock.

roof.definition: The top covering of a building.
roof.example: Cats like to walk on the roof.

starvation.definition: Suffering or death caused by lack of food.
starvation.example: Many animals face starvation in winter.

storm.definition: Violent weather with strong winds and rain.
storm.example: A big storm is coming tonight.

suffer.definition: Experience or be affected by something bad.

vegetation.definition: Plants considered collectively in an area.
vegetation.example: The heavy rain helps vegetation grow.

volcano.definition: Mountain with a vent for magma eruption.
volcano.example: An active volcano can be dangerous.

warm up.definition: To prepare for physical activity by exercising gently.
warm up.example: You should warm up before you start running.

watershed.definition: An event marking a unique, important change.
watershed.example: This agreement is a watershed in our history.

wildfire.definition: A large, destructive fire that spreads quickly.
wildfire.example: A sudden wildfire can destroy a whole forest.

aftershock.definition: A smaller earthquake following a larger one.
aftershock.example: People felt a strong aftershock an hour later.

air pollution.definition: Harmful substances in the air we breathe.
air pollution.example: Large cities often suffer from severe air pollution.

amount.example: We need a small amount of sugar.

at least.definition: Not less than a particular number or amount.
at least.example: You should drink at least eight glasses of water.

disappear.example: The sun will disappear behind the clouds.

distance.definition: The amount of space between two points.
distance.example: The distance between our houses is short.

earthquake emergency kit.definition: Pack of essential items for survival during an earthquake.
earthquake emergency kit.example: Keep an earthquake emergency kit in your house.

food.definition: Things that people or animals eat
food.example: We need to buy some food for dinner.

iceberg.definition: A large mass of ice floating in the sea
iceberg.example: The ship crashed into a giant iceberg.

kill.definition: To cause the death of a person or animal
kill.example: Extreme cold can kill these delicate plants.

land pollution.definition: Damage to the Earth's surface by waste
land pollution.example: Dumping trash causes severe land pollution.

natural disaster.definition: A sudden violent event in nature causing damage
natural disaster.example: An earthquake is a dangerous natural disaster.

lightning.definition: A sudden flash of light in the sky
lightning.example: The lightning brightened the dark sky.

polar.definition: Relating to the North or South Pole
polar.example: Many unique animals live in the polar regions.

recyclable product.definition: An item that can be processed and used again.
recyclable product.example: You should buy a recyclable product instead of plastic.

renewable.definition: Energy from natural sources that never runs out.
renewable.example: Wind power is a great renewable energy source.

save the earth.definition: To protect the planet from environmental damage.
save the earth.example: We must plant more trees to save the earth.

the least.example: This is the least expensive option we have.

toxic waste.definition: Poisonous waste products from industry or chemistry.
toxic waste.example: The factory dumped toxic waste into the lake.

use less.definition: To consume a smaller amount of something.
use less.example: We should use less water every day.

victim.definition: A person harmed or killed as a result of crime.
victim.example: She was the victim of a clever internet scam.

water shortage.definition: A lack of enough water for people's needs.
water shortage.example: The dry summer caused a severe water shortage.

wildlife conservation.definition: Protecting wild animals and their natural habitats.
wildlife conservation.example: She works in wildlife conservation to protect tigers.

blizzard.definition: A severe snowstorm with high winds.
blizzard.example: The strong blizzard lasted for three days.
